submission.justification: S2 at 55% efficiency gives the highest expected significance (4.12 sigma, stat-only), well above S3 (3.32-3.40) and S1 (2.55). The gap is much larger than the ~0.05 simulation scatter. The optimum sits on a plateau (48-62%) and is not at the edge of the allowed range. CAVEAT: no strategy has a data/MC validation-region figure, so the hard 10% constraint is unverified for S2 (and for all alternatives). The recommendation is conditional on S2 passing that check. If S2 fails, fall back to S3 at 55% (3.32 sigma), then re-check it.

requirements.evidence: S2 at 55% gives 4.121 sigma versus 3.319 for S3 and 2.546 for S1, all at 55%. These figures are stat-only.
